hero.heading: Hendry County School Calendar 2026–2027
hero.mobileDescription: School starts August 10, 2026, and ends May 28, 2027. Fall break is October 12–16; students return after winter break on January 6.
hero.desktopDescription: Spring break is March 15–19. Students have classes March 22–25 before the separate Good Friday/Easter holiday on March 26–29. The district also lists seven early-release dates, with regular school hours varying by campus.

editorialSummary.heading: Fall Week Break, the January 6 return and two March holidays
paragraphs: Hendry County schools are closed for Fall Week Break from October 12–16, 2026. Friday, October 9, is still a school day, with early dismissal before the break. Including the surrounding weekends, students have nine consecutive days off, with classes scheduled to resume October 19. Thanksgiving break follows November 23–27.

Winter break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027, but students don't return on January 4. That day is reserved for professional learning, followed by a teacher workday on January 5. Students return Wednesday, January 6. Counting the weekends and two staff days, they have 18 consecutive days without regular classes, from December 19 through January 5.

March is not one continuous break. Spring break runs March 15–19, 2027, and students are scheduled to attend classes March 22–25. The separate Good Friday/Easter holiday runs March 26–29, with classes scheduled to resume Tuesday, March 30.

Students attend school on all seven early-release dates, but the board-approved annual calendar and the 2026–2027 School Times sheet do not specify early dismissal times. On regular days, Clewiston High School dismisses at 2:30 p.m., while LaBelle High School dismisses at 2:40 p.m. Clewiston Early Learning Center lists separate dismissal times for parent pickup (2:30 p.m.) and buses (2:50 p.m.). May 28 is the last student day and is not marked for early release.
highlights: Fall Week Break: October 12–16, 2026. October 9 is an early-release school day.

Spring break is March 15–19; the Good Friday/Easter holiday is March 26–29.

about.dataSource: The supplied scanned one-page Board Approved School Year Calendar is the annual date source. Its SHA-256 matches the current 26-27 School Calendar download on the district Calendar page. The separate two-page 2026-2027 School Times PDF supplies regular school hours. The district’s dated October online calendar supplies the October 20 report-card event.
about.processing: The annual scan has no extractable text; the full rendered page, dated list, colored cells, outlines, legend and approval stamp were read visually. Pink means Student ER/Teacher WD, gray Student ER/Professional Data Day, green grading-period end, purple teacher workday, blue professional day and red vacations/holidays. Gray early-release dates are September 23, November 18, February 10 and April 14; pink dates are October 9, December 18 and March 12. May 28 is green and separately listed as Last Day for Students; it is not an early-release date. The first three quarter endings are October 8, December 17 and March 11, the days before the corresponding workday early releases. No semester boundaries are inferred. The January 6 Students Return caption confirms January 4-5 are student-free; their NON_STUDENT_DAY taxonomy and no-class interpretation are derived. Keep the five official holiday ranges separate from weekend-inclusive planning spans. January 6 return is official; the October, November and March returns are derived. March 22-25 are scheduled attendance dates, separating spring break from the March 26-29 Good Friday/Easter holiday. Count 210 weekdays less 32 no-class weekdays to obtain 178 derived attendance dates; do not assume 180 or claim a printed annual total. Early-release dates count as attendance. The February 17, 2026 Board Approved stamp establishes approval; June 10 scan metadata does not establish publication or revision. Exclude paid-employee holiday numbering, July reporting, pre-year professional learning, 11-month employment markers, post-year workdays and Memorial Day after May 28. Do not confuse grade-posting deadlines in the online calendar with report cards going home. October 20 Report Cards Go Home is confirmed by the full dated October calendar, not by the annual PDF. School Times tables distinguish student start/dismissal, parent/bus drop-off and teacher hours; no teacher clock is published here. Clewiston Early Learning Center has different parent/bus dismissals, and Montura has no row in that sheet, so no time is inferred for it. No early-release clock, lunch rule, senior endpoint or graduation date is inferred. School-hour rows have no invented effective or expiry dates.

faqs.question: When does school start in Hendry County for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of school is Monday, August 10, 2026. Start times vary by campus, so check the district's 2026–2027 School Times sheet for your school's schedule.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Hendry County?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027, is the last student day of the 2026–2027 school year. It is also the end of the fourth grading period.

faqs.question: Is May 28, 2027, an early-release day?
faqs.answer: The board-approved calendar does not mark Friday, May 28, as an early-release day. It is the last student day and the end of the fourth quarter. April 14 is the final early-release date listed on the annual calendar. Confirm any school-specific end-of-year arrangements with your campus.

faqs.question: When is fall break in Hendry County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall Week Break is October 12–16, 2026. Including the surrounding weekends, students are off October 10–18, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, October 19.

faqs.question: Is October 9, 2026, a school day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, October 9, is an early-release day, not a full day off. Students attend school and are dismissed early before Fall Week Break begins on October 12. Confirm the dismissal time with your school.

faqs.question: Is there school on Columbus Day, October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 12, falls within the district's Fall Week Break, so students have no regular classes. The official calendar identifies the closure as part of Fall Week Break rather than a separate Columbus Day holiday.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. With both weekends included, students have November 21–29 off. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break for Hendry County schools?
faqs.answer: The official winter break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students also have no classes January 4–5 because of scheduled staff days. Including weekends, students are away from regular classes December 19 through January 5.

faqs.question: Is December 18, 2026, a school day or the start of winter break?
faqs.answer: Friday, December 18, is an early-release school day, not a full day off. The official winter break begins Monday, December 21. Students attend on December 18 but leave early, so confirm the dismissal time and transportation arrangements with your school.

faqs.question: Do students have school on January 4 or 5, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 4, is a professional learning day, and Tuesday, January 5, is a teacher workday. Both are non-student days before classes resume January 6.

faqs.question: When do students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. Although the official winter break ends January 1, the district has scheduled staff days on January 4 and 5.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Hendry County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15–19, 2027. Including the surrounding weekends, students are off March 13–21, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, March 22. Friday, March 12, is an early-release school day.

faqs.question: When is the Good Friday/Easter school holiday in 2027?
faqs.answer: Hendry County schools are closed Friday, March 26, through Monday, March 29, 2027, for the Good Friday/Easter holiday. This is separate from spring break on March 15–19. Students are scheduled to attend classes March 22–25 and return after the Easter holiday on March 30.

faqs.question: Are Hendry County schools closed on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students have no classes on Monday, September 7, 2026, for Labor Day.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day 2026?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is not listed as a holiday or non-student day on the board-approved calendar, so it is a scheduled school day. Check district announcements for any subsequent change.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a scheduled school holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day.

faqs.question: Are schools closed on Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students have no classes on Monday, February 15, 2027, for Presidents Day.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The seven early-release dates are September 23, October 9, November 18 and December 18, 2026, followed by February 10, March 12 and April 14, 2027. Students attend school on these dates but leave early for scheduled teacher work or professional learning.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The district's annual calendar lists early-release dates but not the dismissal times. The 2026–2027 School Times sheet gives regular school hours, not shortened-day schedules. Confirm early dismissal, parent pickup and bus arrangements with your school.

faqs.question: When do the four grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The four quarters end October 8 and December 17, 2026, and March 11 and May 28, 2027. The first three quarter-ending dates are followed by early-release school days. A quarter ending does not automatically mean students have the day off.

faqs.question: When are report cards sent home?
faqs.answer: The district's online calendar lists Tuesday, October 20, 2026, as Report Cards Go Home for the first quarter. The one-page annual calendar does not provide the remaining report-card dates. Check the district's online calendar and school announcements for later dates.

faqs.question: Do all Hendry County schools have the same start and dismissal times?
faqs.answer: No. Regular schedules differ by campus. For example, Clewiston High School and LaBelle High School both start at 7:30 a.m., but dismiss at 2:30 p.m. and 2:40 p.m., respectively. Elementary schedules also vary. The district's 2026–2027 School Times document provides individual times for its listed schools.

faqs.question: What are the regular hours for high and middle schools in Clewiston?
faqs.answer: Clewiston High School runs from 7:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m., while Clewiston Middle School runs from 7:20 a.m. to 2:20 p.m. At the high school, both bus and parent drop-off are listed at 7:15 a.m. At the middle school, bus drop-off is 6:45 a.m. and parent drop-off is 7:00 a.m.

faqs.question: Do Central, Eastside and Westside elementary schools have the same hours?
faqs.answer: No. Central Elementary School runs from 8:30 a.m. to 3:20 p.m., while Eastside and Westside run from 8:20 a.m. to 3:10 p.m. Central lists parent drop-off at 8:00 a.m. and bus drop-off at 8:05 a.m. Eastside and Westside list both at 7:50 a.m.

faqs.question: What are the regular hours for high and middle schools in LaBelle?
faqs.answer: LaBelle High School runs from 7:30 a.m. to 2:40 p.m., with bus and parent drop-off at 7:00 a.m. LaBelle Middle School runs from 7:20 a.m. to 2:15 p.m., with bus and parent drop-off at 6:45 a.m.

faqs.question: Do LaBelle Elementary, Country Oaks and Upthegrove share the same school hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. All three schools start at 8:15 a.m. and dismiss at 3:05 p.m., but morning drop-off times differ. LaBelle Elementary lists bus drop-off at 7:30 a.m. and parent drop-off at 7:40 a.m. Country Oaks lists both at 7:30 a.m., while Upthegrove lists bus drop-off at 7:40 a.m. and parent drop-off at 7:30 a.m.

faqs.question: What time does Clewiston Early Learning Center dismiss students?
faqs.answer: Clewiston Early Learning Center starts at 8:30 a.m. Parent dismissal is at 2:30 p.m., while bus dismissal is at 2:50 p.m. Morning parent drop-off is at 8:00 a.m., and bus drop-off is at 8:10 a.m. These are regular-day times.

faqs.question: Where can I find my child's school bus pickup time?
faqs.answer: The district's 2026–2027 School Times sheet shows morning bus arrival times at schools, not individual route pickup times. Contact your school or the district's Transportation Department for your child's stop and pickup schedule. Confirm early-release transportation arrangements separately.

faqs.question: What if my child's school isn't listed in the school-hours table?
faqs.answer: The district's 2026–2027 School Times document provides schedules only for the schools it names in Clewiston and LaBelle. For an unlisted campus or separate program, confirm the start, dismissal and drop-off times directly with that school.

faqs.question: How many school days are scheduled in Hendry County for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The published calendar dates yield 178 scheduled student attendance days. That is calculated from 210 weekdays between August 10 and May 28, minus 32 confirmed no-class weekdays. It is not an annual attendance-day total printed in the district's PDF. All seven early-release dates still count as school days.

faqs.question: Are hurricane make-up days listed on the school calendar?
faqs.answer: The board-approved annual calendar does not identify specific hurricane make-up dates or an order in which they would be used. If weather causes a school closure, check district announcements for any changes to the schedule.

faqs.question: Where can I find graduation dates, open houses and other school events?
faqs.answer: The one-page district school-year calendar does not provide graduation or open-house dates. Check the district's online calendar and individual school announcements for graduation ceremonies, open houses, parent conferences and any separate senior schedules.

faqs.question: Does this calendar cover Digital Academy of Florida and Hendry Technical College?
faqs.answer: This page follows Hendry County School District's regular student calendar. Do not assume the same dates or school hours apply to Digital Academy of Florida, Hendry Technical College or other separate programs. Confirm their schedules directly.

faqs.question: Is this the official Hendry County school calendar?
faqs.answer: This is an independent calendar reference based on the district's board-approved 2026–2027 School Year Calendar, stamped February 17, 2026. The district's own PDF is the official source. Check the district calendar page for any later revisions.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official 2026–2027 school calendar?
faqs.answer: Visit the Hendry County School District Calendar page and select 26-27 School Calendar for the board-approved PDF. The same page links the 26-27 School Times sheet and 26-27 General Calendar. Check the district page for subsequent updates.
